source.title: Subthalamic nucleus stimulation reverses mediofrontal influence over decision threshold.

confidence_rationale: Strong human empirical + causal (DBS reversal) evidence that a frontally-set, STN-implemented threshold scales with conflict -- the exact mechanism ARC-063's tolerance-gate borrows. Confidence held mid by mapping caveat: it is a response/decision (drift-diffusion) threshold, not a rule-AVAILABILITY threshold; REE extends the mechanism to a new target.
failure_signatures: The measured threshold is a motor-response evidence-accumulation bound (drift-diffusion boundary), not a gate on which abstract RULE becomes available; mapping the STN conflict-threshold onto rule-availability is an architectural extension, not a demonstrated identity.

STN DBS REMOVED the adaptive coupling (produced impulsive choice), so the mechanism is necessary for the adaptive threshold -- a REE tolerance-gate without an STN-analog dynamic-adjustment pathway would predict the same impulsive failure mode.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Trial-to-trial increases in mPFC theta (4-8 Hz) raise the evidence-accumulation decision threshold as a function of decision conflict; STN DBS reverses this mPFC->threshold relationship, producing impulsive choice; STN-area activity (2.5-5 Hz) increases during high-conflict decisions.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-063's tolerance-gated availability is a frontally-set, basal-ganglia/STN-implemented DYNAMIC threshold: a candidate rule becomes AVAILABLE only once accumulated support clears a bar that is RAISED under conflict (competing rules / accumulated exceptions). The cortico-subthalamic 'hold your horses' pathway is the biological analog of the gate that keeps a not-yet-supported rule out of the active set.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a response-time decision threshold over a single motor choice, NOT a gate on rule availability. REE borrows the MECHANISM (frontal-set, conflict-scaled, STN-implemented dynamic threshold) and applies it to a different target (rule availability). The transfer is biologically motivated but not empirically demonstrated for rules.
mapping.source_context: Human EEG (decision conflict, drift-diffusion modelling) + intracranial STN recording + STN deep-brain-stimulation in Parkinson's disease.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (Nature Neuroscience, causal DBS manipulation). Mapping fidelity mid: mechanism transfers cleanly, target (rule vs response) does not. Transfer risk mid: clinical (PD) + motor-decision -> healthy rule-availability.
